decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box for sewers builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling expertise and its utility customers, so it fits the core business and costs little to keep.

Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and face established competitors, but they serve existing public-sector buyers and use the firm's metal and coating skills, so a small firm would likely give them more than one year.
The ground sleeve line is a simple fabricated product close to the firm's capabilities and fits its municipal and contractor customers.
Cast iron sleeves may be bought in rather than made in-house, which makes them somewhat more likely to be consolidated, but they round out the ground sleeve range at low cost.
Steel ground sleeves rely directly on the firm's steel processing and in-house surface treatment, so they are a natural fit with the established business.
